_meta.purpose: Records from the original pilot data whose IS number BIS's own records do not bear out, and the real standard each one stood for.
_meta.rule: build_full_corpus.py keeps a pilot record only when BIS's Know Your Standard record lists that exact edition, or the archive holds the published standard itself. Every other pilot record is dropped and must be listed here, so a new one cannot slip through unexplained.
_meta.use: Links, certification rules and query labels that named a dropped number are moved to 'by'. 'by' is null where the number belongs to a different standard altogether, so nothing is moved.
_meta.checked_against: data/amendments/bis_kys.json (BIS's Know Your Standard records, read 28 September 2026) and data/archive/ingested_standards.json

IS 8112:2018.reason: No 2018 edition exists. BIS withdrew IS 8112 (43 grade OPC) and merged it into IS 269:2015.

IS 12269:2019.reason: No 2019 edition exists. BIS withdrew IS 12269 (53 grade OPC) and merged it into IS 269:2015.

IS 12894:2020.reason: BIS lists IS 12894:2002 (pulverized fuel ash-lime bricks) as the current edition and no 2020 edition.

IS 14255:2018.reason: BIS lists IS 14255:1995 (aerial bunched cables) as the current edition and no 2018 edition.

IS 1554 (Part 1):2020.reason: BIS lists IS 1554 (Part 1):1988 (PVC insulated heavy duty cables) as the current edition and no 2020 edition.

IS 1879:2020.reason: BIS lists IS 1879:2010 (malleable cast iron pipe fittings) as the current edition and no 2020 edition.

IS 2185 (Part 3):2021.reason: BIS lists IS 2185 (Part 3):1984 (autoclaved cellular concrete blocks) as the current edition and no 2021 edition.

IS 3589:2019.reason: BIS lists IS 3589:2001 (steel pipes for water and sewage) as the current edition and no 2019 edition.

IS 4270:2020.reason: BIS lists IS 4270:2001 (steel tubes for water wells) as the current edition and no 2020 edition.

IS 4926:2017.reason: BIS lists IS 4926:2003 (ready-mixed concrete) as the current edition and no 2017 edition.

IS 8329:2018.reason: BIS lists IS 8329:2000 (ductile iron pressure pipes) as the current edition and no 2018 edition.

IS 8043:2020.reason: No 2020 edition exists. BIS lists IS 8043:1991 (hydrophobic Portland cement) as withdrawn with no replacement.

IS 6913:2021.reason: BIS lists IS 6913:2023 (stainless steel tubes) as the current edition and no 2021 edition.

IS 1239 (Part 1):2014.reason: BIS's Know Your Standard record lists IS 1239 (Part 1):2004 as current and no 2014 edition. BIS's Scheme I list prints the number as 2014; its certification entry is read by standard, so it still applies.

IS 3495 (Part 1):1992.reason: BIS lists IS 3495 (Part 1):2019 (burnt clay brick tests: compressive strength) as current; the 1992 edition was published as Parts 1 to 4 together.

IS 15298-2:2016.reason: Misprinted designation. BIS writes it IS 15298 (Part 2):2016 (safety footwear), withdrawn in favour of IS 15298 (Part 2):2024.

IS 17505:2021.reason: BIS publishes only Part 1 (fire survival cables); a record without the part number named no real standard.

IS 4984:2016/Amd 1.reason: An amendment, not a standard. BIS counts the amendments of IS 4984:2016 on its own record.

IS 516:2021.reason: BIS publishes IS 516 in parts. Part 1 Section 1 (compressive, flexural and split tensile strength) is the 2021 part the record described.

IS 694 (Part 2):2016.reason: BIS has no Part 2 of IS 694. IS 694:2010 covers PVC insulated cables and flexible cords.

IS 13270:2013.reason: BIS's IS 13270 is a test for gases by Orsat and chromatographic methods, not fibres for concrete as the record said. The number belongs to another standard.

IS 2416:2016.reason: BIS's IS 2416 (1986) covers boiler and superheater tubes for marine and naval purposes, not heat exchanger tubes as the record said, and has no 2016 edition.

IS 1914 (Part 4):2018.reason: BIS has no record of this part or edition.
